title: Reject negative purchase quantity
issue: POST /orders accepts quantity <= 0 and returns 201; contract requires 422.
regression_focus: valid order creation and response schema

title: Fix page boundary off-by-one
issue: GET /items?page=2&size=10 skips item 11 because offset math is wrong.

title: Return 404 for missing resource
issue: GET /users/<id> returns 200 with null when the user does not exist.

title: Handle malformed JSON without 500
issue: POST /events raises internal error on malformed or missing JSON.

title: Await asynchronous repository lookup
issue: GET /profiles/{id} fails because a repository call is not awaited.

title: Map domain NotFound to 404
issue: Service NotFoundError reaches framework and becomes 500.

title: Preserve normalized email across service and schema
issue: Registration lowercases email for lookup but stores/returns an unnormalized value through another layer.

title: Prevent cache-key collisions across query parameters
issue: GET /search caches only by path, so different query strings can share the wrong result.
regression_focus: cache still works for identical requests

title: Fix status code without breaking response contract
issue: DELETE /sessions/{id} has wrong status; naive fix can erase required response metadata.

title: Honor environment timeout without string-type bug
issue: Client timeout from environment is passed as a string and causes incorrect runtime behavior.

title: Avoid partial state update after validation failure
issue: PATCH /profile mutates one field before validating the rest.

title: Prevent duplicate job creation after retry
issue: POST /jobs with same Idempotency-Key can duplicate jobs when first request times out after persistence.
hidden_acceptance: same key after timeout -> one stored job
regression_focus: job creation, key isolation, response identity
